ward.summary: Borivali (ward R/C) spent ₹33.1 lakh against a ₹29.0 lakh budget, so it used 114% and is over budget. Across 86 jobs, 14% were redone within 30 days, better than the 24% expected, though repairs that failed still account for ₹5.4 lakh. Timeliness was 59%, in line with the expected 56%. Two jobs are listed for review. Separately, ₹14.6 lakh was paid on 30 jobs on roads under warranty. The ward has 22 open issues costing ₹9.2 lakh, led by cave-in repairs on Western Express Highway and Gorai Road at ₹1.9 lakh each. With ₹0 left, no open issue fits the budget, so money must be reallocated or warranty payments recovered.
